command: bash -c date; date -u; echo; uname -a; hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname; uptime; echo; cat /etc/os-release
bash -c cat /etc/sudoers; for f in /etc/sudoers.d/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done
journalctl -q --no-pager -o short-iso --since 1 days ago SYSLOG_FACILITY=4 SYSLOG_FACILITY=10
bash -c for h in /root/.bash_history /home/*/.bash_history; do [ -r "$h" ] && grep -HnE "\b(wget|curl|nc|ncat|nmap|base64|chmod \+x|/dev/tcp)\b" "$h"; done; true
bash -c cat /etc/crontab; ls -la /etc/cron.*; for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; true
